notes.title: Update Notes for 1.3.3 (macOS only)
notes.content:
- Fixed rendering issues on macOS Big Sur
- Fixed launch crash on older macOS versions

The older macOS build can be found in [i]macos_old[/i] branch, in case the newer build doesn't work on older macOS versions. To change the branch for a game:

[olist]
[*] Right click the game, and select [i]Properties...[/i].
[*] Select [i]Betas[/i].
[*] Select the branch from [i]Select the beta you would like to opt into[/i] drop-down list.
[*] Close the window. The game should update to reflect the selected branch.
[/olist]
